cases.sentence: Там не было ___, чтобы утолить жажду.
cases.translation: There was no water there to quench their thirst.
cases.explain: After the negated existential не было the noun stands in the genitive.

cases.translation: The people wanted to quench their thirst.
cases.explain: The transitive verb утолить takes a direct object in the accusative.

cases.sentence: Моисей встал на вершине холма с Божьим ___ в руках.
cases.translation: Moses stood on the top of the hill with God's rod in his hands.
cases.explain: The preposition с in the sense of 'with' governs the instrumental case.

cases.translation: I will stand before you on the rock.
cases.explain: The preposition на indicating location takes the prepositional case.

cases.translation: What shall I do with this people?
cases.explain: The preposition с in the sense of 'with' governs the instrumental case.

cases.translation: Moses cried out to the Lord.
cases.explain: The verb взмолиться takes its object in the dative case.

cases.translation: Why did you bring us out of Egypt?
cases.explain: The preposition из governs the genitive case.

cases.translation: A hand was lifted to the throne of the Lord.
cases.explain: The preposition к governs the dative case.

reading.ru: Они расположились лагерем в Рефидиме, но там не было воды, чтобы утолить жажду.
reading.question: Why did the people begin to complain at Rephidim?
options: There was no water to drink
reading.correct: There was no water to drink
reading.explain: The text says at Rephidim 'не было воды, чтобы утолить жажду' (there was no water to quench their thirst).

reading.question: What did Moses do when the people were ready to stone him?
options: He cried out to the Lord
reading.correct: He cried out to the Lord
reading.explain: The text states plainly 'Моисей взмолился Господу' (Moses cried out to the Lord).

reading.ru: Ударь по скале, из нее потечет вода, и народ сможет утолить жажду
reading.question: What did the Lord say would happen when Moses struck the rock?
options: Water would flow out of it
reading.correct: Water would flow out of it
reading.explain: The Lord said 'из нее потечет вода' (water will flow out of it) when Moses struck the rock.

reading.ru: Когда Моисей поднимал руки, израилетяне побеждали, но едва он опускал руки, побеждали амаликитяне, потому что руки у Моисея уставали.
reading.question: When did the Israelites prevail in the battle?
options: When Moses held up his hands
reading.correct: When Moses held up his hands
reading.explain: The text says 'Когда Моисей поднимал руки, израилетяне побеждали' (when Moses raised his hands, the Israelites prevailed).

reading.ru: Тогда Аарон и Хур взяли камень, положили под него, и он сел.
reading.question: How did Aaron and Hur help Moses when his hands grew tired?
options: They put a stone under him to sit on
They carried him down the hill
They took the rod from him
reading.correct: They put a stone under him to sit on
reading.explain: The text says they 'взяли камень, положили под него, и он сел' (took a stone, put it under him, and he sat down).

reading.ru: Моисей воздвиг жертвенник и назвал его «Господь мое знамя», потому что он сказал, «Рука была воздета к престолу Господа.
reading.question: What did Moses name the altar he built?
reading.explain: The text says Moses built an altar and 'назвал его «Господь мое знамя»' (called it 'the Lord is my Banner').
